To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
high estimates of genetic parameters for yield and yield contributing traits and quality traits in rice were recorded, indicating greater genetic control and high selection response.

the estimates of heritabilities in broad sense were higher for the yield components and kernel traits, which suggested that the additive genetic effects played a greater role in the inheritance of the traits and the chances of obtaining the desirable segregants with high yield and quality are very high through the direct selection.

the estimates of heritabillity in broad sense with high genetic advance were recorded in aromatic rice for the yield component and kernel traits viz panicle length, no. of filled grain/panicle, 1000 grain wt., kernel length and L / B ratio.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the genetic improvement of grain yield and grain quality in rice.
the development of a new rice cultivar with improved grain quality, which is expected to be useful for rice improvement in the future.
the development of high yielding and aromatic rice cultivars with good grain quality and resistance to diseases.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the present study has revealed the presence of considerable genetic variability for yield and kernel traits in aromatic rice, which can be exploited for further improvement through proper selection.
the genetic parameters estimated in this study would be useful in developing high yielding and quality rice cultivar with desired grain type through selection and hybridization.
the present study revealed that the crosses have shown high genetic variability and heritability coupled with high genetic advance for grain yield and quality traits in aromatic rice.

the genetic diversity in rice is not only confined to the wild species but is also present in the cultivated varieties.
